reason: I might try the free version for the habit stuff, but linking my bank account to a brand-new app from one developer with zero reviews is a no for me. And I don't pay for utility apps anyway, so Pro isn't happening.
objection: Who is this one person, and what happens to my bank data if the app shuts down next year or gets hacked? No reviews and no company behind it.
would_change_my_mind: Lots of good Play Store reviews from people like me plus a clear privacy policy saying my bank data is never stored or sold, and even then I'd stay on free unless a friend showed me the AI coach was actually worth it.
